# BuddyBird (버디버드)

> BuddyBird is a mobile app that teaches pet parrots to speak. AI repeats target
> words to the bird through a phone speaker, listens to the reply through the
> phone microphone, scores how closely the parrot mimicked the word, and picks
> the next word — so training continues while the owner is away from home.
> No hardware beyond a smartphone is required. Free on iOS and Android.
>
> BuddyBird 는 반려 앵무새에게 말을 가르치는 모바일 앱이다. 보호자가 자리를 비운
> 사이에도 AI 가 단어를 반복해 들려주고, 마이크로 앵무새의 반응을 들어 발음을
> 채점한 뒤 다음 단어를 고른다. 스마트폰 외의 장비는 필요 없고, iOS·Android 무료.

Not to be confused with **Bird Buddy**, the smart bird-feeder hardware company.
BuddyBird is an unrelated software product for pet parrot owners, made by
joynnovate. 새 모이통 하드웨어 Bird Buddy 와는 무관한 별개의 서비스다.

## How it works

1. **Sound input** — the phone microphone collects the parrot's vocalizations and cage noise.
2. **Sound analysis** — MFCC and DTW algorithms measure pronunciation accuracy and how closely each target word was mimicked.
3. **Adaptive coaching** — an LLM recommends the next word and difficulty level, and writes a plain-language guide for the owner.
4. **Reports** — the next session continues automatically and progress is delivered as a report with recordings.

## Facts

- Category: pet care / parrot training, mobile app (iOS and Android)
- Price: free (a monthly subscription may be introduced later)
- Equipment needed: a smartphone only — no additional hardware
- Languages: Korean, English
- Maker: joynnovate
- Species support: not species-specific today; species-tailored training is planned
